rag.text:
Test: TC-5936 — SPM - OKR - OKRs without linked Jira issues is displayed on modules when added to box scope
Priority: High | Status: Done | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/SPM/OKR/TS-514 OKR - Box scope - OKR linked work
Labels: spm-mikolaj-tc

Steps:
1. Open OKR module of boxName and create Strategic theme, Objective and Key-result
   Data: * boxName: TC-5936 SPM - OKR - OKRs without linked Jira issues is displayed on modules when added to box scope
* Strategic-1
** Objective-1
*** KR-1
   Expected: ST, OBJ and KR is created and visible in OKR module
2. Navigate to scope definition → OKR linked work →  add KR-1 to scope → Save
   Expected: Key-result is added to the scope
3. Go to task structure and enable OKR task structure
   Expected: OKR task structure is enabled
4. Open Gantt module
   Expected: Strategic theme, Objective and Key-result is displayed on Gantt
5. Open Scope module
   Expected: Strategic theme, Objective and Key-result is displayed on Scope
6. Navigate to scope definition → OKR linked work → remove KR-1 and add Objective-1 to scope → Save
   Expected: Key-result is removed. Objective is added to the scope
7. Open Gantt module
   Expected: Strategic theme, Objective and Key-result is displayed on Gantt
8. Navigate to scope definition → OKR linked work → remove Objective-1 and add Strategic-1 to scope → Save
   Expected: Objective is removed. Strategic is added to the scope
9. Open Gantt module
   Expected: Strategic theme, Objective and Key-result is displayed on Gantt
10. Go to BP Overview and create new boxName
   Data: boxName: newBox1
   Expected: Box is created and visible in BP Overview
11. Navigate to scope definition → OKR linked work → add KR-1 to scope → Save
   Expected: Key-result is added to the scope
12. Open OKR Overview → click *Link to box* button and hover over to OKR checkboxes
   Expected: Strategic theme, Objective and Key-result is connected to the box automatically.
After hovering to checkboxes message is displayed *_"This item was automatically added to this box and cannot be removed"_*
